definitions: A phrase indicating that an individual or entity continues to improve or advance, even as their peers or competitors reach a point of stagnation or cease to make progress.
Describes a situation where one party maintains upward momentum or growth, contrasting with others who have reached a limit in their development or performance.
examples: She kept innovating, while others plateau.
His career continued to soar, while others plateau.
The company's market share grew significantly, while others plateau.
